name: Voyager Infinity
niche: UK recruitment agency CRM and ATS (Ikiru People)
notes: Site says: "Voyager Infinity integrates the multi-job posting solution LogicMelon." Brand of Ikiru People Ltd, a subsidiary of Dillistone Group Plc. Multi-job posting to job boards via Broadbean and LogicMelon integrations. Contact page returned HTTP 502 and was not readable.

connections.quote: Jobs from the Infinity database are automatically sent to Broadbean for dispatch to the largest network of job boards in the world.
Jobs from the Infinity database are automatically sent to LogicMelon for dispatch to your selection of their extensive job board network.
The partnership enables organisations to source and access millions of CVs from CV-Library

review.note: Home, about and partners pages read; contact page returned HTTP 502 in the browser reader after one retry.
